description: This file defines a MediatR pipeline behavior that manages database transactions by wrapping request handling in transaction control (begin, commit, rollback) within the Conduit infrastructure context.

classes.name: DBContextTransactionPipelineBehavior
classes.description: A pipeline behavior for MediatR that manages database transactions during request processing by beginning a transaction, handling commits or rollbacks based on success or failure.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the request by wrapping its processing in a database transaction, committing if successful, or rolling back if an exception occurs.
